items.heading: La Bandera Dominicana
details: Key ingredients: rice, red beans, stewed meat, plantain, salad
Cook white rice and a pot of stewed red beans.
Braise chicken or beef in a seasoned tomato sauce.
Fry sweet or green plantains until golden.
Serve the rice, beans, meat, plantain and a simple salad together on one plate.

items.heading: Mangu
details: Key ingredients: green plantains, red onion, vinegar, oil
Boil green plantains until very soft.
Mash the plantains with a little of the cooking water until smooth.
Pickle thin red onion slices quickly in vinegar and oil.
Top the mashed plantains with the pickled onions before serving.
